items.title: 30 laptops · 3-month rental
items.body: Sorry, make that 30 laptops, not 25. We're in JLT if that matters.

context.label: Earlier customer message · evt_0001
context.body: Hi, we need 25 MacBook Airs for a 3 month training programme starting 1 Dec. Can you do a better price for that volume?

reasons.title: Customer requested a volume discount
reasons.detail: No percentage was requested. This sample uses the catalogue rate with no discount.

reasons.title: Commercial quote requires review
reasons.detail: Review the corrected quantity, delivery charge, and any discount before making a commitment.

quote.note: Rental estimate only. Delivery/setup (Q-SVC-001, AED 150 before VAT) is excluded until the arrangement is confirmed. No discount applied.

items.draftReply: Thanks for the update — I have noted 30 MacBook Air laptops for 3 months from 1 December in JLT. At the catalogue rate, the rental estimate is AED 17,010 including 5% VAT, before delivery/setup. I will ask our sales lead to review your volume-discount request. Will you need delivery and setup?

items.title: 5 iPhone 16 · purchase
items.body: السلام عليكم، أبغى ٥ آيفون 16 للشركة، شراء مو إيجار. كم السعر شامل الضريبة؟

reasons.title: Firm price needs named approval
reasons.detail: Purchase, not rental. Confirm the price and ask for the delivery location without promising availability.

quote.note: Product total only. Delivery is excluded; the customer has not supplied a location.

items.draftReply: وعليكم السلام، سعر شراء ٥ أجهزة آيفون 16 سعة 128 جيجابايت هو ⁦AED 17,844.75⁩ شامل ضريبة القيمة المضافة ٥٪، ولا يشمل التوصيل. في أي مدينة ترغبون بالاستلام أو التوصيل؟ سنؤكد التوفر وترتيبات التسليم بعد المراجعة.

items.title: New-joiner equipment · Abu Dhabi
items.body:
FW: adding a vendor quote

Forwarded request from Omar: 12 new joiners on 16 November. We need a laptop and a 27-inch monitor each for 6 months at our Abu Dhabi office. Delivery on 15 November, please.

reasons.title: Outside the service area
reasons.detail: Qamar serves Dubai and Sharjah. A person must handle this request before quoting or promising delivery.

items.draftReply: Thanks for the details. Our standard service area is Dubai and Sharjah. I will pass your Abu Dhabi request to our team to check what may be possible. We have not confirmed equipment availability or delivery for 15 November.

items.title: 25 laptops · replaced by correction
items.body: Hi, we need 25 MacBook Airs for a 3 month training programme starting 1 Dec. Can you do a better price for that volume?

reasons.title: Newer customer message
reasons.detail: evt_0003 changes the quantity to 30. This draft cannot be approved.

items.draftReply: Thanks — I have noted 25 MacBook Airs for a 3-month rental. Our team will review the volume-pricing request.

items.title: Graduation event · stage & seating
items.body: السلام عليكم، عندنا حفل تخرج يوم الخميس 19 نوفمبر في الرياض. نحتاج ٣٠٠ كرسي و٣٠ طاولة دائرية ومسرح ٦×٤ متر وشاشة كبيرة. كم التكلفة؟ وأبي تأكيد إنكم متوفرين ذاك اليوم

reasons.title: Availability cannot be promised
reasons.detail: Only the operations manager can confirm availability. This draft asks for details and does not confirm a booking.

reasons.title: Crew required; quote incomplete
reasons.detail: The 24 m² stage exceeds 12 m². Include one crew shift; screen and delivery are still unpriced.

quote.note: Partial estimate: screen and delivery excluded. One crew shift is included. No availability or booking confirmation.

items.draftReply: وعليكم السلام، سجلنا طلبكم لحفل 19 نوفمبر في الرياض: ٣٠٠ كرسي و٣٠ طاولة ومسرح ٦×٤ متر. ما أبعاد الشاشة المطلوبة؟ سنراجع التوفر مع مديرة العمليات ونجهز عرضًا مفصلًا يشمل التجهيز والتوصيل. لم يتم تأكيد التوفر أو الحجز بعد.

items.title: LED screen · above SAR 9,000 budget
items.body: We need a 4 × 3 m LED screen for two event days and 2 wireless mics in Riyadh. Our total budget is SAR 9,000. شكرًا

reasons.title: Estimate exceeds the customer budget
reasons.detail: SAR 12,604 including VAT is SAR 3,604 above budget, before delivery. No discount is assumed.

reasons.title: Crew required
reasons.detail: A 12 m² screen exceeds 6 m²; include one setup crew shift.

quote.note: Delivery excluded. The sample assumes one crew shift for the order; operations must confirm requirements.

items.draftReply: شكرًا لتواصلكم. التقدير للشاشة ٤×٣ متر لمدة يومين مع ميكروفونين وطاقم تجهيز هو ⁦SAR 12,604⁩ شامل الضريبة، قبل التوصيل، وهو أعلى من ميزانيتكم البالغة ⁦SAR 9,000⁩. هل تناسبكم مراجعة حجم الشاشة أو مدة الإيجار؟ نحتاج أيضًا تاريخ الفعالية لمراجعة التوفر.
